routes: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Qualified lead billing queue

rows.action: Confirm owner approval for a controlled lawyer test identity and controlled test email/phone.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Owner approval note, test identity, test email inbox owner, test phone owner.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if the identity is a real lawyer/client who did not consent to the test.

rows.action: Confirm payment path to test: manual invoice only, Grow payment link, Meshulam link, Morning invoice or no-charge dry run.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Selected payment path, provider link or explicit no-charge note.
rows.stop_condition: Stop before any charge unless provider link and amount are owner-approved.

rows.action: Run current static and live read-only gates before touching live records.
rows.evidence_to_capture: .project-control/lawyer-subscription-e2e-preflight-2026-05-27.md and .project-control/lawyer-revenue-funnel-live-2026-05-27.md when refreshed for the same day.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if either gate returns REVIEW, BLOCKED_STATIC_GATES or stale checker warnings.

rows.action: Verify homepage stays legal-help-first and lawyer path is secondary.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Screenshot or report row showing user-first homepage, quiet lawyer CTA and no internal revenue-plan language.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if homepage exposes internal revenue/business-plan language.

rows.action: Open lawyer plans page and choose lead_partner manual-invoice path.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Plan selected, URL params, pricing context, manual-invoice fallback visible.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if pricing or plan copy promises guaranteed leads/results.

rows.action: Open checkout fallback and verify billing fields, terms, cancellation and privacy links.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Required field list, checked terms link, cancellation link, privacy link.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if terms checkbox or cancellation/privacy links are missing.

rows.action: Submit controlled lawyer registration with plan_interest and payment_path preserved.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Registration URL, form values without sensitive ID docs, success screen, created profile/post ID.
rows.stop_condition: Stop before submit unless owner approved live record creation.

rows.action: Open the created lawyer profile/onboarding record and verify billing metadata and manual payment queue.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Profile/post ID, plan type, billing legal name, invoice email, payment_followup_status, manual_invoice_reference.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if billing metadata is missing or profile is public before approval.

rows.action: Add approved manual payment link or invoice reference and send payment-link email only to controlled inbox.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Manual payment link URL, invoice reference, sent timestamp, recipient controlled inbox proof.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if email recipient is not controlled or link amount/provider is not approved.

rows.action: Log in as the controlled lawyer user and verify dashboard plan status, payment link, service request presets and lead-stage form visibility.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Dashboard URL, linked profile ID, payment CTA state, available presets, no unassigned lead PII visible.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if the dashboard exposes leads not assigned to the controlled lawyer.

rows.action: Submit one controlled request each for payment link, upgrade, downgrade, cancel, refund and invoice.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Service request IDs, request types, statuses, timestamps and linked lawyer profile.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if any request triggers automatic refund/charge/cancel without owner approval.

rows.action: Attach one consented controlled lead to the controlled lawyer and update lead stage from dashboard.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Lead ID, consent status, routing_hold state, assigned lawyer ID, stage update note.
rows.stop_condition: Stop if the lead is not consented, not controlled or contains real client PII not approved for the test.

rows.action: Record qualified lead billing status, invoice reference and payment evidence URL before counting revenue.
rows.stop_condition: Stop before marking paid if invoice/payment evidence is missing.

rows.action: Summarize what passed, what failed, and whether money may be counted.
rows.evidence_to_capture: Final owner-approved walkthrough summary with links to private evidence artifacts.
rows.stop_condition: Do not send public success update or revenue claim if any proof field is missing.
